name: Ink language
author: Edgemodders
description: The test of the ink API's phase I2d: text in the player's language. A HUD panel with the game's own text by key, the package's own text from locales/en-us.json and locales/fr-fr.json with a parameter, plurals and V's gender, a key French lacks and one no file has. Switch the game's language and watch it follow. Needs Codeware.
